title: shipped_pages.json — the derived listing of every page and tool that ships
description: GENERATED by 13_Faculty_Resources/_automation/site_build/shipped_pages.py from site_manifest.json, cotw_registry.json and site_extras.py, and verified against the real build output on every build (build_and_check.sh). Never hand-edited. See ADR-002-shipped-pages-single-source.md.

generated_from.description: sha256 of each producer file at generation time. Informational — it lets a reader explain a staleness failure. The gate is regenerate-and-diff (--check), never a hash comparison.

slug.description: The built filename, and the key reviewed.json and the faculty console use. Unique across the whole list.

kind.description: page ships to /content/<slug>; tool ships to /tools/<slug>.

sites.description: Which learner deployments publish it, sorted. A resident-only item is exactly ["res"].

title.description: Display title, as the site nav and the faculty console show it.

source.description: Repo-relative source path. For a page both sites ship where the resident build overwrites it from its own source (welcome.md, cotw_index.md), this is the shared/MS3 source.

producer.description: Which route puts it on a site. site_manifest = the shared md/tools lists; ms3_extra_tool = copied by build_deploy.py from _prototypes/ (orientation video); cotw_registry = derived per week by cotw_slug.py; resident_extra / resident_tool = copied by resident_section.py from site_extras.py.
